title: GOVERNED AUTONOMY, POLICY, AND OPERATIONAL ORCHESTRATION

P4-G0_BASELINE.command: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
P4-G0_BASELINE.evidence: Phase 3 baseline verified: 268 suites, 2549 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed. No Phase 3 regression.

P4-G1_POLICY_MODEL.evidence: AutonomyPolicyModel with 9 policy rules covering OBSERVE, RECOVER, RESTART, ESCALATE. Each policy has capability, target, conditions, authorization, risk, max_attempts, cooldown, required_evidence, escalation. No arbitrary shell execution.

P4-G2_RISK_MODEL.evidence: RiskClassifier with R0-R5 levels. R0=autonomous, R1=autonomous, R2=policy_authorized, R3=human_required, R4=human_required, R5=prohibited. Confidence ≠ authorization enforced.

P4-G3_ACTION_SELECTION.evidence: ActionSelector: deterministic selection from state + graph + policy + risk. LLM may propose hypothesis, deterministic selector decides. Never LLM → shell. Idempotent: HEALTHY → NO_ACTION.

P4-G4_AUTHORIZATION.evidence: CapabilityAuthorizer integrated with ActionSelector. confidence ≠ authorization: high confidence does not authorize prohibited actions. Low confidence may allow safe reversible recovery.

P4-G5_INCIDENT_CORRELATION.evidence: IncidentCorrelator enhanced with correlation IDs, timeline, actions, probableCause, confidence. Downstream failures correlated with root cause. escalateIncident and recordAction methods added.

P4-G6_RECOVERY_BUDGETS.evidence: RecoveryBudgetManager: per-component retry budget, per-incident action budget, circuit breaker (trips after N consecutive failures, cooldown period). No infinite recovery loops.

P4-G7_DECISION_RECORDS.evidence: PolicyDecisionRecordStore: durable JSONL records with decisionId, incidentId, correlationId, component, observedState, evidence, candidateActions, selectedAction, risk, policy, authorization, executor, result, reason, verification, timestamp. Persisted to .hydi-operational/policy-decisions.jsonl.

P4-G8_ESCALATION.evidence: EscalationManager: ESCALATION_REQUIRED state, operator-readable packages with evidence, attempted actions, policy stopped reason, recommended next action, risk, affected components. Live demo: circuit breaker tripped → escalation package produced.

P4-G9_CONCURRENCY.evidence: RecoveryLockManager: recovery lease with holderId, acquire/release, timeout. Second acquire for same component returns null. Prevents competing autonomous recovery loops.
limitations: Lock holderId not stored in RecoveryEngine for explicit release — relies on lease timeout

P4-G10_SECURITY.evidence: 12 security tests: R5 prohibited, R3/R4 human_required, no arbitrary shell execution, command allowlisting, idempotent policy, dry-run no side effects, no scope creep, state machine boundaries. No policy bypass detected.

P4-G11_DRY_RUN.evidence: Dry-run mode shows full decision chain: observe → diagnose → policy → authorize → (no execute). Live demo: protoforge-core killed, dry-run correctly showed policy would allow recovery without executing.

P4-G12_LIVE_GOVERNED_AUTONOMY.evidence: Live end-to-end demo: real protoforge-core kill → failure detected → policy evaluated (policy.recover.protoforge-core) → risk R1 → authorization ALLOWED → restart_process executed → postcondition verified HEALTHY → decision recorded durably. Also demonstrated: circuit breaker tripped → ESCALATION_REQUIRED → operator-readable escalation package.
limitations: DEP0190 child_process shell warning (pre-existing from Phase 3)

P4-G13_REGRESSION.command: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
P4-G13_REGRESSION.evidence: Typecheck: PASS. Lint: 0 errors, 791 warnings. Full regression: 272 suites, 2615 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed. Phase 3 tests: 51 passed. Phase 4 tests: 66 passed. No Phase 3 regression.
limitations: 791 lint warnings (pre-existing 768 + 23 new from Phase 4 modules, all warnings not errors)

liveDemonstrations: Governed recovery: protoforge-core kill → policy → auth → recovery → verify → decision record
Circuit breaker denial: tripped breaker → ESCALATION_REQUIRED → operator-readable package
